one_liner: Implemented components and refined patterns for PMI's redesigned certification experience using a structured design system and Radix UI primitives.
projectSummary: Contributed to PMI's major redesign by building front-end components, refining interaction patterns, and implementing structured system workflows using Radix UI and design tokens.

problem.summary: The certification experience needed a clearer, more cohesive design system that could scale across complex content while maintaining consistency.

goals: Translate design tokens into reliable, reusable components
Support a scalable and consistent design system
Streamline UI behavior across certification flows
Ensure alignment between Figma specs and front-end implementation
responsibilities: Built and refined React components using Radix UI primitives
Implemented styles and behaviors based on detailed design tokens
Collaborated with designers to match spacing and interaction patterns
Addressed bugs and supported QA to stabilize interface behavior
Created a PR checklist template to improve engineering workflow
outcomes: Delivered consistent, reusable components for PMI’s redesigned certification platform
Improved clarity and system alignment across UI patterns
Strengthened engineering workflow through a structured PR checklist
